info.name: ChannelShipper & Royal Mail Public Labels API
Return a single PDF file with generated label and/or associated document(s)

params.name: orderIdentifiers
params.description: One or several Order Identifiers or Order References separated by semicolon. The maximum number of identifiers is 100.

params.name: includeReturnsLabel
params.description: Include returns label. Required when documentType is set to 'postageLabel'.
